# onetsolutions_web_hosting (Data Source)

Looks up a web hosting of a project by `id` or by `domain`.

Web hostings are ordered in the console; this data source reads them, for instance to point DNS
records at them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "onetsolutions_web_hosting" "shop" {
  domain = "shop.example.fr"
}

data "onetsolutions_dns_zone" "example" {
  zone_name = "example.fr"
}

# Point a record of a zone at the web hosting's dedicated address.
resource "onetsolutions_dns_record" "shop" {
  zone_id = data.onetsolutions_dns_zone.example.id
  type    = "A"
  name    = "shop"
  content = data.onetsolutions_web_hosting.shop.dedicated_ip
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `domain` (String) The primary domain of the web hosting. Exactly one of `id` and `domain` is required.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the web hosting. Exactly one of `id` and `domain` is required.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization to read from. Defaults to the provider's `organization_id`.
- `project_id` (String) The project to read from. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `bandwidth_limit_mb` (Number) The monthly bandwidth allowed, in MB; 0 means unlimited.
- `bandwidth_usage_mb` (Number) The bandwidth used this month, in MB.
- `billing_cycle` (String) The billing cycle, such as `monthly`.
- `created` (String) When the web hosting was created (RFC 3339).
- `dedicated_ip` (String) The dedicated IP address, when one is assigned.
- `disk_limit_mb` (Number) The disk space allowed, in MB.
- `disk_usage_mb` (Number) The disk space used, in MB.
- `nameservers` (List of String) The name servers to delegate the domain to.
- `next_billing_date` (String) The next billing date (RFC 3339), when one is scheduled.
- `plan_id` (String) The UUID of the plan (see `onetsolutions_hosting_plans`).
- `plan_name` (String) The name of the plan.
- `price` (String) The price per cycle, in EUR, as a decimal string.
- `status` (String) `pending`, `active`, `suspended`, `terminated`, `cancelled` or `failed`.
- `username` (String) The account's login name.
